content.text:
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Miguel Velasco <Miguel.Velasco@fox.com>
Sent: Monday, February 23, 2015 5:52 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony
Cc: Erin Woods; Barry Forbis
Subject: FS1 Remote Productions, LLC -w- Anthony Fenech 
 
Hi Anthony,

Please find attached an agreement between FS1 Remote Productions, LLC and you, regarding your provision of services as a Correspondent for various programming for FOX.  Please review the agreement and, if acceptable, please sign the agreement and the included Freelance Work Rules and return both to my attention via email or fax (at the number below).
If you have any questions or comments, please contact me at the number below.
